# Parse the file content to extract song titles and artists.
import re
content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist"
        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        parts = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist = parts[1].strip()
            songs_to_archive.append((title, artist))
print(songs_to_archive)

    playlist_song_map[pl_id] = song_ids
